intro.text: One of the Fused, of the shanay-im, who wears long clothing.

items.text: Thousands of years ago, Hoid danced with Vatwha; since then she has been trained to watch for him.
After the Siege of Kholinar, she hovered over the city as a sentry. Hoid passed beneath her in disguise and she barely glanced at him; he decided not to take it as an insult.
